component.name: LetraItem
component.script: function init() as void m.fundo = m.top.findNode("fundo") m.letra = m.top.findNode("letra") m.top.observeField("itemContent", "onConteudo") m.top.observeField("focusPercent", "onFoco") m.top.observeField("gridHasFocus", "onFoco") end function function onConteudo() as void m.letra.text = m.top.itemContent.title end function function onFoco() as void f = m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 and m.top.gridHasFocus m.fundo.visible = f if f then m.letra.color = "#0B0E14" else m.letra.color = "#F7F7FA" end function
